scripts.push-migrations: with-env supabase db push && pnpm generate-types
scripts.reset-remote-database: with-env supabase db reset --linked && pnpm generate-types && pnpm seed-buckets
scripts.generate-types: with-env supabase gen types --linked > src/database.types.ts && pnpm build
scripts.start-local-stack: with-env supabase start && with-env supabase status -o env > ../../.env.generated && pnpm seed-buckets:local
scripts.reset-local-database: with-env --local supabase db reset && with-env --local supabase gen types --local > src/database.types.ts && pnpm build && pnpm seed-buckets:local
scripts.generate-types:local: with-env --local supabase gen types --local > src/database.types.ts && pnpm build
